---
title: "InstaCart"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: cosmo
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(flexdashboard)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(p8105.datasets)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```


Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Top 10 Departments** by Orders Count

```{r echo=FALSE}
instacart |>
  count(department) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 10) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~department, y = ~n, type = "bar") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Department"), yaxis = list(title = "Orders Count"))
```

### **Orders Distribution** by Hour of Day

```{r}
instacart |>
  count(order_hour_of_day) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_hour_of_day, 
    y = ~n, 
    type = "scatter", 
    mode = "lines+markers") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Hour of Day"), yaxis = list(title = "Number of Orders"))
```


Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Orders Count by Aisles in the **Produce Department**

```{r}
instacart |>
  filter(department == "produce") |>
  count(aisle) |>   
  plot_ly(
    x = ~reorder(aisle, -n),      
    y = ~n,                       
    type = "bar"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Aisle", 
      tickangle = -30
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Orders Count"
    )
  )
```

### **Order Size Distribution** by Hour of Day

```{r}
instacart |>
  group_by(order_id, order_hour_of_day) |>
  summarise(order_size = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~as.factor(order_hour_of_day), 
    y = ~order_size, 
    type = "box"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Hour of Day"), 
    yaxis = list(title = "Order Size"),
    margin = list(b = 50)
  )
```
